subject: EverRoad: consolidation of renewal + topup invoicing, request for proforma and net terms shift
messages:
From: EverRoad Procurement <procure@everroad.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Hsieh <dana.hsieh@everroad.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@everroad.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: PO attached — consolidation for renewal + capacity topup; request net60

Hi Marcus,

Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing EverRoad’s renewal (starting 2027-07-01) and a near-term capacity top-up we agreed to in May. Finance would like to consolidate the two charges under a single PO for vendor onboarding simplicity.

Attached: EverRoad_PO_789.pdf and our W-9 (EverRoad_W9.pdf).

Two asks from our end:
- Can Redwood accept a single PO that covers the renewal term + the one-time topup?
- Can you provide a proforma invoice that matches the PO line items so we can route it to Treasury?
- We would also like to request Net60 payment terms for this renewal cycle (current contract is Net30). Please confirm if that’s feasible or whether Redwood needs a partial prepay.

Billing contact should be updated to: billing@everroad.com (Attn: Dana Hsieh).

Thanks — we need the proforma to complete internal approvals by next Tuesday.

Best,
Jared Collins
Procurement Manager
EverRoad Inc.
[attachment: EverRoad_PO_789.pdf (pdf)]
[attachment: EverRoad_W9.pdf (pdf)]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: EverRoad Procurement <procure@everroad.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 10 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: PO attached — consolidation for renewal + capacity topup; request net60

Hi Jared — thanks for the clear note and attachments.

We can absolutely accept a single PO for both the renewal and the one-time top-up; I’ll confirm application to the renewal line items in the proforma. I’m looping in Priyom (sales lead on this account) and Monica (billing/finance) to coordinate the invoice and terms.

Quick items I’ll check:
- Our finance team’s ability to move to Net60 for this customer (I’ll propose Net45 as a middle ground if needed).
- Whether we require any additional contractual amendment for the term change. If legal needs to sign an amendment I’ll surface that to Carlos.

We’ll aim to get a proforma and a suggested payment schedule over to you within 48 hours.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
[signature: Redwood Inference]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: EverRoad PO consolidation + Net60 request — quick alignment

Priyom / Monica — forwarding EverRoad’s PO and W-9. Jared is asking for: single PO to cover renewal + one-time topup, proforma matching PO, and Net60. They updated billing contact to billing@everroad.com (Dana).

My thinking: offer Net45 instead of Net60, and propose the Net45 applied to the renewal invoices while the topup can be invoiced as a prepay or Net30 depending on finance appetite. If customer pushes, consider a small onboarding credit (5% on the topup) to offset cash flow burden.

Monica — can you draft a proforma that:
- consolidates the renewal MRR and the one-time topup as line items with Redwood SKU references,
- reflects both Net45 and an attached statement that Net60 requires leadership approval, and
- lists billing contact as billing@everroad.com?

Priyom — if we need a credit concession I’d like to know the margin impact so we can approve quickly.

Thanks — I’ll hold off replying to Jared until we have the proforma.

Onward,
Marcus
---
[Quoted text from EverRoad Procurement <procure@everroad.com> at 2027-06-10 09:12:00 -0700]
> Hi Marcus,
> 
> Hope you’re well. We’re finalizing EverRoad’s renewal...

From: Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 13 Jun 2027 10:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: EverRoad PO consolidation + Net60 request — proforma attached

Marcus / Priyom — draft proforma attached (Redwood_Proforma_Invoice_789.pdf). Summary below:
- Renewal (12 months) — $120,000 — Invoice 1 (Net45 suggested)
- Capacity one-time topup — $30,000 — Invoice 2 (we recommend prepay or Net30)
- Suggested concession: 5% credit on topup ($1,500) if we accept Net60 on renewal only

Notes:
- I added a clause: "Net60 requests subject to Finance approval; acceptance of Net60 for renewal will be documented in an Amendment to Master Services Agreement (MSA)" with a link placeholder for the amendment.
- Billing contact switched to billing@everroad.com per their note.

Attachments: Redwood_Proforma_Invoice_789.pdf (contains line-item breakout and GL codes).

If you want to offer Net45 instead of Net60, I can update the proforma and note the same concession.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Billing Lead, Redwood Inference
monica@redwood.com
[attachment: Redwood_Proforma_Invoice_789.pdf (pdf)]

From: Dana Hsieh <dana.hsieh@everroad.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Jared Collins <procure@everroad.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@everroad.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 14:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proforma received — confirmation + request for DocuSign

Marcus — thanks for the quick turnaround and the proforma. We reviewed internally and can accept the split invoicing approach (renewal Net60; topup prepay), contingent on receiving the MSA amendment and a signed acknowledgement of the credit.

Requests:
- Please send the MSA amendment for signature (Carlos will need to review the language).
- Please provide a DocuSign envelope for the proforma + acknowledgement so Treasury can complete the PO routing.
- Confirm that the EverRoad PO number will be applied to both the renewal and the topup lines on Redwood’s invoices.

We’d like to close this by EOD Friday to meet our internal procurement cutoff for next cycle.

Best,
Dana Hsieh
VP Finance — EverRoad Inc.
[dana.hsieh@everroad.com]

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
To: Dana Hsieh <dana.hsieh@everroad.com>, Jared Collins <procure@everroad.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica@redwood.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@everroad.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Jun 2027 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Proforma received — docuSign envelope + amendment next steps

Hi Dana — great, thanks. Next steps on our side:
- Monica will issue the DocuSign envelope for the MSA amendment + proforma acknowledgement (you’ll see an envelope from docusign@example).
- We’ll mark the invoices with PO# 789 across both line items as requested.
- Priyom and I will escalate the Net60 approval to Finance; Monica has noted the 5% topup credit in the proforma and a line indicating Net60 is pending approval.

I’ve asked Monica to attach the DocuSign link and the amended proforma as soon as they’re ready. Expect docusign.example in your inbox within the hour.

Appreciate the speed here — we’ll aim to have everything signed before your Friday cutoff.

—Marcus
